workshoptitle: Build Connected Media & Entertainment Solutions with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: The Seer Media Midnight Harbor launch-weekend story and workshop goals.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the environment and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Midnight Harbor Launch Operations Dashboard
tutorials.description: Connect audience signals, content similarity, campaign orders, and distribution geography.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a JSON Campaign Application Model
tutorials.description: Compare JSON columns, JSON collections, and duality views for campaign-order data.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Review a Semantic Content Search
tutorials.description: Search prepared content-asset embeddings by meaning.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Investigate a Creator and Studio Network
tutorials.description: Follow creator connections and relationships with shared studios or labels using SQL/PGQ and Graph Studio.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Route Audience Accounts to the Closest Distribution Hub
tutorials.description: Find audience accounts in a region and identify the closest active distribution hub for each account.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Content Demand Watchlist with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Train a content-demand model with the loader settings and score a simulated activity snapshot.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Media Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Generate SQL from media questions, inspect it, and compare the answers with database results.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Media Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Create a media assistant with one SQL tool, check its answer, and review its execution history.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding with scored questions.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
